involucro.piedeNota: Automated message: please do not reply to this address.

codice.oggetto: {codice} is your code to enter Prome
codice.anteprima: The code is valid for {minuti} minutes.
codice.istruzioni: Enter it in Prome within {minuti} minutes. After that it expires and you need a new one.
codice.ignora: If you didn't ask to sign in, ignore this message: without the code nobody can get in.

notificaCommento.oggetto: Someone commented on your post on Prome
notificaCommento.anteprima: Open the post to read the comment and reply.
notificaCommento.istruzioni: Someone commented on something you published. Open the post to read the comment and reply.
notificaCommento.gestione: You can turn these emails off in Settings → Notifications, inside Prome.

invitoAula.oggetto: {invitante} invites you to a study room on Prome
invitoAula.titolo: You have been invited to a study room
invitoAula.istruzioni: {invitante} invited you to “{titoloAula}”. Open the invitation to join: if you do not have an account yet, all it takes is an email address and a minute.
invitoAula.ignora: If you do not know who invited you, ignore this message: nobody joins without your acceptance.

invitoGruppo.oggetto: {invitante} invites you to the group {nomeGruppo} on Prome
invitoGruppo.titolo: You have been invited to a group
invitoGruppo.istruzioni: {invitante} invited you to «{nomeGruppo}», a study group on Prome. Members join the group’s study rooms without needing an invitation each time.
invitoGruppo.ignora: If you do not know who invited you, ignore this message: nobody joins without your acceptance.

segnalazione.anteprima: A piece of content has been reported: review within 24 hours.
segnalazione.istruzioni: Someone reported a piece of content. The guidelines promise a response within 24 hours: review it, and remove it if it breaks the rules.
segnalazione.estratto: Excerpt of the reported content (first 300 characters):
